description:
Find citation-graph candidates from one to ten `seed_ids`; the first ID is the primary seed and later IDs are anchors. `mode` defaults to `similar` (co-citation/bibliographic coupling); `citers` returns papers citing a seed and `references` papers cited by a seed. `intent` ranks candidates.

Returns ranked candidates and the evaluated pool size.

rerank.description: Apply an additional rerank over the fused candidates.

name: firecrawl_research_related_papers

outputSchema.description: Ranked citation-graph candidates and the size of the evaluated pool.

agent_hints.description: Optional response guidance from the Firecrawl API.

note.description: Note about how the candidates were produced.

poolSize.description: Number of candidates evaluated before ranking.

authors.description: Authors, as a comma-joined string or as `{name, affiliation}` entries.

createdDate.description: Date the paper was first indexed or published.

ids.description: Source identifiers by namespace, such as `arxiv`, `doi`, or `pmid`.

primaryId.description: Display identifier, ordered for citation and fetch use.

updateDate.description: Date the paper was last updated.

title: Firecrawl related research papers
